# bbox each nonbackground component, fill interior of rectangular outlines; color mapping
from collections import deque

def transform(g):
 h,w=len(g),len(g[0]); out=[r[:] for r in g]; seen=set()
 for i in range(h):
  for j in range(w):
   col=g[i][j]
   if col==4 or (i,j) in seen: continue
   q=[(i,j)]; seen.add((i,j)); pts=[]
   while q:
    y,x=q.pop(); pts.append((y,x))
    for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
     a,b=y+dy,x+dx
     if 0<=a<h and 0<=b<w and (a,b) not in seen and g[a][b]==col: seen.add((a,b));q.append((a,b))
   y0=min(y for y,x in pts);y1=max(y for y,x in pts);x0=min(x for y,x in pts);x1=max(x for y,x in pts)
   fill={5:7,6:2,9:2}.get(col,2)
   for y in range(y0+1,y1):
    for x in range(x0+1,x1):
     if g[y][x]==4: out[y][x]=fill
 return out
out=transform(grid)
